articles.title: New pension tax allowance explained - as crucial £13,319 figure revealed
articles.summary: The new state pension will rise to £13,036.40 in April - putting it over the £12,570 personal tax allowance.

articles.title: Check if you benefit from budget change to gas bills
articles.summary: Chancellor John Healey has revealed the government plans to scrap gas standing charges in 2027.

articles.title: Suppliers threaten to cut ties with Poundland as chain nears collapse
articles.summary: Major suppliers are moving to cut ties with Poundland as the discount chain lurches towards an insolvency process which threatens to unleash thousands of job losses.

articles.title: What the budget means for your money - all in one place
articles.summary: Savers, drivers and pensioners were among those at the centre of Wednesday's key budget announcements.

articles.title: Profits up billions at both UK's biggest mortgage provider and major oil producer
articles.summary: The UK's largest mortgage lender has seen profits nearly double as customers pay higher interest rates.

articles.title: US makes interest rate decision - as Bank of England verdict looms
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve has left interest rates unchanged - despite persistently high inflation and repeated calls from Donald Trump to lower borrowing costs.

articles.title: JPMorgan Chase faces £100m-plus tax bill from Healey raid
articles.summary: JPMorgan Chase will pay additional taxes of between £100m and £150m as a result of the corporation tax surcharge hike announced by John Healey in his budget on Wednesday - a bill which could renew doubts about the construction of its new London headquarters.

articles.title: Ofwat hands EY £15m contract to monitor troubled Thames Water
articles.summary: EY, the big four accountancy firm, has landed a £15m contract to supervise Thames Water, the troubled water utility which stands on the brink of collapse.

articles.title: Ex-City minister raises millions for insurance AI start-up i23
articles.summary: A former City minister has raised millions of pounds in funding for an AI-driven start-up which will target the vast global insurance broking market.

articles.title: Main budget announcements at a glance
articles.summary: Chancellor John Healey has unveiled the long-anticipated budget, the first for Prime Minister Andy Burnham.
